red-flags.title: Red flags before deeper research
red-flags.intro: Answer from primary sources. "Don't know yet" is a valid answer and tells you what to read first.

items.text: Has the auditor resigned or been changed in the last three years?
Does the auditor's report carry a qualification, emphasis of matter, or adverse remarks under CARO?
Are related-party transactions large relative to revenue or profit, or growing?
Have promoters pledged a meaningful share of their holding?
Is cash flow from operations persistently lower than reported profit?
Are receivables or inventory growing much faster than sales?
Are contingent liabilities large relative to net worth?
Is the company capitalising costs that peers expense?
Has there been frequent equity dilution or preferential allotment to promoters?
Have the CFO, company secretary or independent directors left abruptly?
Is there any regulatory order, penalty or investigation against the company or promoters?
Are disclosures thin, delayed, or inconsistent between filings and presentations?
